method.name: reviewed_serial_limits_v1
method.assumptions: Nominal serial ceilings only; subject coverage and packed copies can vary. Higher limits are upper bounds. Hobby and FDI pack odds remain separate source vectors and are never combined into production estimates. Each nameplate letter is a distinct numbered 1/1 card, not an entire player nameplate set. No non-autograph complete-tier production calibration is established.
